about: Rules from apps/todomvc/ROUTES.md and the planted bugs that break each one. Saboteur's report uses this to show which rules would break without any test noticing.

requirements.text: Adding trims the title; an empty or spaces-only entry adds nothing
A todo's checkbox toggles it between active and completed
Toggle all marks everything completed, or everything active if all are completed
Editing saves the new text; saving an empty title deletes the todo
The delete button deletes only that todo
Clear completed deletes completed todos and keeps active ones
The counter shows active todos: "1 item left!" or "N items left!"
Active and Completed views show only matching todos
Todos are kept in memory only; reloading empties the list
